Everything is working. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

---

**Files created/modified:**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML 4.0.2` package |
| `Program.cs` | Registers `TicketClassifierService` singleton (trains model at startup) |
| `Models/TicketData.cs` | DTOs: `TicketInput`, `TicketPrediction`, `PredictRequest/Response`, `MetricsResponse` |
| `Services/TicketClassifierService.cs` | ML pipeline: text featurization → feature concatenation → SDCA Maximum Entropy classifier, with 3-fold cross-validation metrics |
| `Controllers/TicketController.cs` | Two endpoints with input validation |

**Endpoints:**

- **`POST /api/ticket/predict`** — classifies a ticket into Billing, Technical, or General with confidence scores
- **`GET /api/ticket/metrics`** — returns cross-validation metrics (macro/micro accuracy, log-loss)

**ML Pipeline:** Featurizes `Subject` and `Description` text, concatenates with `Priority`, and trains an SDCA Maximum Entropy multiclass classifier. The model correctly predicted all three categories in testing (Billing 61%, Technical 60%, General 97% confidence).
